notice: Offline safety red-team cases for scripts/redteam_safety.py. Fictional data: the demo story handoff_day1/care_cases/episode_hip_fracture.json and Cases A/B (scenario_normal.json, scenario_correction.json). Every input is the shape the real function takes; where a function needs a model, the case gives the model's fixed (adversarial) output, played back in process. A known_gap case keeps the safe expectation and documents that the deterministic code does not meet it today.

outcomes.block: rejected: never shown and never stored as a fact
outcomes.hold: kept out of the current picture, or shown only labelled (family report, not confirmed, said earlier, two answers) or withheld for review
